title: Lost Communication With Body Control Module "C"
plain: Other computers in the car have stopped hearing from the body control module "C". It runs many body features such as lights, locks, wipers and the security system.
symptoms: Several warning lights on at once
Lights, locks or wipers may act strangely
Car may not start or the battery may drain

causes.name: The body control module "C" lost power or ground (blown fuse or bad ground)
Damaged, corroded or loose network wiring or connector
Weak battery or low system voltage
Failed body control module "C"
Another module shorting out the network

checks: Test the battery and charging voltage first
Check the fuses, power and ground for the body control module "C"
See which modules answer a scan tool to narrow down the break
Inspect network wiring and connectors near the module
fix: Restore power, ground or wiring to the body control module "C"; replace the module only after those test good.
